preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, Node)
preconditions.description: The input root must be either None or an instance of the Node class representing the root of the binary tree with random pointers.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, Node) for node in [root] + [root.left, root.right, root.random] if node is not None)
preconditions.description: Every node in the tree (including root, left, right, and random pointers) must be an instance of the Node class or None.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.val <= 1000 for node in [root] + [root.left, root.right, root.random] if node is not None)
preconditions.description: The value of every node in the tree must be an integer between 1 and 1000 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: return_value is None or isinstance(return_value, Node)
postconditions.description: The function returns either None or a Node instance representing the root of the cloned tree.

postconditions.expression: return_value is None if root is None else True
postconditions.description: If the input root is None, the function returns None; otherwise, it returns a cloned tree root.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value.val == root.val if return_value is not None else True)
postconditions.description: The value of the cloned root node matches the value of the original root node.

postconditions.expression: all((clone.left.val == original.left.val if clone.left is not None and original.left is not None else (clone.left is None and original.left is None)) for clone, original in [(return_value, root)] + [(clone.left, original.left), (clone.right, original.right), (clone.random, original.random) for clone in [return_value] + [return_value.left, return_value.right, return_value.random] if clone is not None for original in [root] + [root.left, root.right, root.random] if original is not None])
postconditions.description: For every node in the cloned tree, its left, right, and random pointers point to the corresponding cloned nodes (or None) if they exist in the original tree.

postconditions.expression: all(clone.val == original.val for clone, original in [(return_value, root)] + [(clone.left, original.left), (clone.right, original.right), (clone.random, original.random) for clone in [return_value] + [return_value.left, return_value.right, return_value.random] if clone is not None for original in [root] + [root.left, root.right, root.random] if original is not None])
postconditions.description: Every node in the cloned tree has the same value as its corresponding node in the original tree.
